The result concerns admissible coefficient words at a shared initial width and eight complete carry observations, including the final carry of each word. It does not apply to only overflow bits or a partial low-carry prefix.
The universal conclusion is equality at active indices below two. The separate q1 theorem requires width at least two; the active-coordinate corollary does not constrain inactive singleton tails.

No unrestricted full pair-sum, initial-digit, initial-integer, or next-integer reconstruction follows from these endpoint statements, and no Lychrel existence or palindrome-avoidance theorem is claimed.
